children: Overview
Europe field services provider's H1 2026 revenue fell 11% as French telecom contract exited
Adjusted EBITDA for H1 2026 dropped 46%, margin fell to 4.2% amid restructuring
Company expects improved profitability in 2027 after completing transformation and refocusing on energy, tech
Outlook
Company expects transformation to be fully completed by end-2026, exiting loss-making French telecom operations
Solutions30 anticipates a marked improvement in margins from 2027, driven by business mix and cost structure changes
Company to focus on high-growth energy and technology markets, including power grids, data centers, and solar power
Result Drivers
FRENCH TELECOM EXIT - Co said withdrawal from major loss-making French telecom contract drove revenue and margin declines
RESTRUCTURING COSTS - Restructuring of French operations and downsizing to match new activity level weighed on profitability
GERMAN CUSTOMER SHIFT - Margin decline in Germany attributed to repositioning customer base and exit from FiberCo contract
